name: Production Distro RC14
source: RC13 final audit; maestro-managed RC14 planning
goal: Plan and execute AIOS-body local execution readiness for drift-zero, freshness, object trust, verified quarantine, executable AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecution allow envelope, exact approval, controlled activation, rollback, and support/recovery evidence.
core_thesis: AIOS becomes Ubuntu-like distributable only when local release trust can move from fail-closed denial into auditable execution readiness without giving authority to mirrors, signers, shells, TUI projections, model replay, remote dispatch, or production ring mutation.
non_goals: Do not build mirror frontend, nginx, TLS, remote signer, object storage, or remote dispatch infrastructure in RC14 body tasks.
Do not read, copy, print, hash, move, or reference private signing material.
Do not claim GA production readiness.
Do not treat mirror reachability, signer reachability, frontend output, shell output, TUI output, model replay, object storage UI, or remote service reachability as authority.

Do not install, activate, rollback, mutate boot metadata, mutate active slots, mutate active artifact sets, mutate production rings, upload support bundles, or dispatch remote fleet actions unless a later task proves every gate and records the effect explicitly.
primary_acceptance: RC14 plan is active and task-managed with RC14-001 as the next executable task.

The plan covers drift-zero repair, freshness window, local object trust, verified quarantine preflight, AgentCore executable PlanSpec, SecurityExecution allow envelope, canary identity enrollment, exact approval, controlled activation, rollback, support/recovery, and final audit.

The plan preserves AIOS-body-only scope and keeps mirror frontend, nginx/TLS, signer infrastructure, object storage provisioning, remote dispatch, private signing material, and production ring mutation out of scope.
The plan keeps production_ready_claim=false until final audit proves every required gate.
